name: Spider-Punisher
description:
Peter Parker traded webs for bullets.
On Earth-71928, Peter Parker picked up the Punisher's war. His Web-Shooters fire Armor-Piercing, EMP, Explosive and Incendiary rounds, and every upgrade he readies at the end of the turn becomes another shot. Exhaust upgrades to take to the air, reload mid-swing and turn your board into an arsenal, while the Green Goblin and a Revealed Identity close in. Includes a Leadership starter deck. 22 cards. English and Spanish. Pairs with Sinister Motives.
